name: That Fruity Feelin'
source:
This Fruity Feelin' immerses you in the romantic world of a lonely cynical banana.

Boasting an assortment of fresh produce, a variety of exciting date locales, and over 500 lines of dialogue, That Fruity Feelin' is the #1 fruit-based dating simulation on the market! Fall madly in love with the fruit of your dreams and weep at the cruel machinations of fate when you're summarily rejected! Unless you have what it takes to win their fruity hearts...

[From [url=https://digital-worlds-institute.itch.io/that-fruity-feelin]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《That Fruity Feelin'》让你沉浸在一根孤独又愤世嫉俗的香蕉的恋爱故事中。

游戏里有各式各样的新鲜农产品、丰富多彩的约会地点和500多行对白，号称市面上排名第一的水果主题恋爱模拟游戏！与梦中情果坠入爱河；若你被无情拒绝，也会为命运的捉弄而落泪！除非你有本事赢得水果们的芳心……

[来源：[url=https://digital-worlds-institute.itch.io/that-fruity-feelin]Itch.io[/url]]
